data.one_liner: Adds swipe to go back functionality to custom or non-Cupertino routes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a detector widget that wraps your UI to enable swipe-to-pop navigation gestures. It allows customization of detection area width, cutoff velocity, vertical padding, and pop values.
use_when: You are using custom routes that lack default swipe-to-back behavior
You need to implement iOS-style edge swipe gestures on non-Cupertino routes
avoid_when: You require RTL (right-to-left) language support, which is currently not implemented
You are already using standard Cupertino routes that handle back swipes natively
strengths: Easy customization of swipe area width and cutoff velocity
Simple widget wrapper approach for custom routes
weaknesses: Does not currently support RTL layouts
data.minimal_example:
SwipeBackDetector(
  child: MyScreen(),
  cutoffVelocity: 300.0,
  swipeAreaWidth: 20.0,
  popValue: true,
)
